testNames: column continuation sends exact opaque cursor plus the original server filters
canonical placement forwards actual first/last/before/after intent and anchor IDs
filtered snapshots forward priority-none and AbortSignal instead of filtering a cached page
archived-board admin discovery is explicit and preserves the default list URL
actual server filter translation preserves supported priority-none, assignee, date and title semantics
continued pages expose card24 without duplicating a boundary or replacing full counts by loaded length
a real15-card first page continues through card31 with stable ID order and no duplicate boundary
a changed snapshot, calendar day or filter never combines old continuation cards/cursors
dropping after the last loaded card asks after that anchor rather than pretending the full column ended
Manager controls cannot promote or change self, peer Manager or Owner, while Owner can administer others
full directory remains Owner/Manager only and stale cached emails disappear on role loss or refused read
comment and card activity reads forward opaque cursors and preserve the next page envelope
versioned comment edit and delete send exact IDs, mention spans and retained operation keys
committed lost reply retries the original comment payload/key through the real API client
quick-add retains expected board version and original explicit priority after an unknown 503
definitive validation refusal permits a new edited intent, in-flight submissions share one request
a synchronous validation failure does not leave the next operation stuck on a rejected request
a later authorization refusal cannot erase an earlier unknown committed operation
cursor pages keep order, replace edited/deleted duplicates and reject cursor loops
roles distinguish author editing from moderation and never grant Viewer write controls
comment create/edit drafts remain actor/card-scoped through remount and clearing one draft keeps the other
edit restores actual UTF-16 spans, leaves malformed spans literal, and IME Enter is ignored
retained column history refuses without a fake remedy or hidden counts
every code the contract lists has a catalogue entry
every entry reads like the style guide, for every role
the server message is never shown, for every code, every class and an unknown code
unknown codes fall back by status class
request id shows only for server faults and unknown codes
assignee refusal by role: Owner gets Open People, Manager and Member get the ask line and no button
assignee refusal by reason: viewer and left-the-project
read-only by reason and role
403 on a hidden resource reads like 404; quota without current has no digits except the limit
offline keeps the work: status 0 says changes are still here and offers retry
rate limit: seconds, minutes, and the Retry-After header as a fallback
read-only without a reason does not guess between project and board
quota copy always names the limit and only shows a count the server sent
every code in the shared ERROR_CATALOG has its own catalogue entry, and reads well at its listed status
codes with two statuses read the same at either
client-caused 400s do not blame the server, and no note promises a reference that is not shown
a plain 403 never tells an Owner to ask an Owner, and small file limits never read
the mention query sends the card id, keyed by card, and the client method puts it in the URL
with a second member, candidates appear and are searchable
a Viewer with board access can be mentioned; someone without a grant or who left cannot
empty wording: loading, failed, only you, no match
listbox pattern: combobox textarea, listbox, options named
saved mentions show the current full name on hover, not the stored text
